fixtures.html:
Nunjucks macro options
Name Type Description
Name id Type string Description The ID of the table.
Name rows Type array Description Required. The rows within the table component. See macro options for rows.
Name head Type array Description Can be used to add a row of table header cells (<th>) at the top of the table component. See macro options for head.
Name caption Type string Description Caption text.
Name captionClasses Type string Description Classes for caption text size. Classes should correspond to the available typography heading classes.
Name firstCellIsHeader Type string Description If set to true, the first cell in each row will be a table header (<th>).
Name classes Type string Description Classes to add to the table container.
Name attributes Type object Description HTML attributes (for example data attributes) to add to the table container.
